d:
Josh Gates travels across the world to investigate extraordinary historical mysteries, search for lost treasures and uncover clues hidden in ancient sites. From dangerous expeditions to unexpected discoveries, each journey brings him face-to-face with stories that have fascinated explorers and historians for generations. But will the evidence lead to answers, or leave even bigger questions behind?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 7, Episodes 5, 3, 6 and 9, and Season 4, Episodes 2, 4 and 8, on Discovery Channel India.
